exposure: Robotic repair of cesarean scar defects/pregnancies with uterine sound guidance
Laparoscopic repair of cesarean scar defects/pregnancies with uterine sound guidance
outcome: Subjective changes in symptoms (e.g., postmenstrual vaginal bleeding)
Objective changes in depth and width of cesarean scar defects
cohort: The study included 20 consecutive women with cesarean scar defects or cesarean scar pregnancies who underwent robotic or laparoscopic repair with a uterine sound guidance.
finding: Robotic or laparoscopic repair with a uterine sound guidance appears to be a feasible and effective method for the treatment of cesarean scar defects or cesarean scar pregnancies, showing symptomatic improvement and objective changes in scar dimensions.
